description: Ex-INS Rajali Tu-142M reassembled as the centrepiece walk-through exhibit of the Navy open-air museum inaugurated 30 May 2026 by Raksha Mantri and the UP CM, opened to the public 16 June 2026 (PIB, Hindustan Times). Serial not reported - candidates are the remaining ex-INAS 312 airframes. A Sea King Mk 42B was also announced for the site (Deccan Chronicle Mar 2025) but arrival is unconfirmed.
aliases: Tu142M Lucknow; Bear F; Shaurya Vatika; Tu142; Tu142M
